findings.title: Missing Error Handling in killTracked Function
findings.evidence: The function attempts to read PID files but ignores any errors that occur during file reading or parsing, which could lead to processes not being terminated properly.
findings.impact: Potential failure to kill processes, leading to orphaned processes that may consume system resources or cause unexpected behavior.
findings.reproduction: If a PID file cannot be read or parsed, the function will not attempt to kill the associated process, leaving it running indefinitely.
findings.fix: Add proper error handling to log or retry reading the PID file instead of silently ignoring the error.

findings.title: Incomplete Error Handling in MQTT Broker Check
findings.evidence: The MQTT client error handler does not properly handle errors, leading to potential resource leaks or incomplete cleanup.
findings.impact: If an error occurs during the broker check, the client may not be properly closed, leading to resource leaks or unexpected behavior.
findings.reproduction: An error in the MQTT client connection attempt will not trigger proper cleanup, potentially leaving the client in an inconsistent state.
findings.fix: Ensure the client is properly closed and any errors are logged or handled more gracefully in the error callback.
